senses.gloss:
† 1. शठ् शठ्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To deceive.
 2. To kill or hurt.
 3. To suffer pain.
 --i. 10, Par. To be lazy.
† 2. शठ् शठ्, शट् शट्, शल् शल्, [] i. 10, Ātm. To praise, to flatter.

† 3. शठ् शठ्, श्वठ् श्वठ्, i. 10, शथय, श्वठय, Par.
 1. To speak ill.
 2. To speak well.
 3. To be true.

† 4. शठ् शठ्, श्वठ् श्वठ्, श्वण्ठ् श्वण्ठ्, सठ् सठ्, स्वठ् स्वठ्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To finish, to adorn.
 2. To leave unfinished or unadorned.

शठ शठ, probably akin to शत्रु, cf. शतेर, perhaps a form of *शत्र,
 I. adj. Wicked, dishonest, perfidious, Lass. 31, 17; Hit. ii. d. 115.
 II. m.
 1. A rogue, a knave, Man. 7, 123.
 2. A false husband or lover, Lass. 45, 5; Śṛṅgārat. 10; Mālav. d. 55 (read शठ).
 3. An idler.
 4. A blockhead.
 5. A mediator.
 --Comp.

शाठ्य शाठ्य, i. e. शठ + य, n.
 1. Deceit, Hit. i. d. 99, M.M.
 2. Wickedness.
 3. Perfidy, hatred, Bhartṛ. 2, 19.
